case: A declared class floor changes with no authorized `ProtectedChange` naming it.
why: This is the W10 self-modification probe, and before the repair it resolved the wrong way on all six control objects: `ProtectedChange` is well built, its `baseline_subject_refs` is enum-typed over every record type, and NO edge on any of the six required one. Three of the six were not records at all. The mutation makes `protected_change_ref` optional again on `ConsequenceClassDefinition`, whose every transition IS a change to a declared class floor -- so the floor that decides who may act on an action moves through an ordinary transition owned by an ordinary component. The guard's binding is `optional: true` because ConfigurationVersion's benign case needs it, which is exactly why the presence half has to be checked here.
expect_failure_contains: A CONTROL OBJECT MAY CHANGE WITH NO PROTECTED CHANGE NAMED
